projects.title: SBA National Case
projects.summary: Built predictive models to assess small business loan repayment risk with profit-aware evaluation, threshold tuning, and model comparison across several classifiers.
projects.detailSummary: This project used the SBA loan dataset to compare KNN, decision trees, ensemble methods, logistic regression, and neural networks with a business-focused scoring lens. Instead of stopping at accuracy, the notebook tuned thresholds around precision, loan default risk, and estimated profit impact.
insights: Cleaned and encoded core SBA loan features including term, employees, business status, revolving credit, LowDoc, geography, and disbursement amounts.
Compared multiple classification families rather than relying on a single model, including KNN, decision trees, boosting, bagging, random forest, logistic regression, and neural networks.
Tuned decision thresholds using a profit-oriented business rule so the final recommendation reflected lending tradeoffs instead of raw accuracy alone.

projects.title: Safe Meetup Dataset
projects.summary: Collected and cleaned public location data for safe buyer-seller recommendations, including addresses, coordinates, hours, and categories.
projects.detailSummary: At Kolosseum Marketplace, I supported the safe meetup recommendation effort by preparing structured public location data for product use. Because the work sits under NDA, this page stays at the level of the public-facing problem: making in-person buyer-seller exchanges easier to evaluate with cleaner, more usable location information.
insights: Researched and organized public meetup-location information that could support safer exchanges inside a peer-to-peer marketplace context.
Prepared structured fields such as addresses, coordinates, operating availability, and category labels so the dataset was more product-ready and easier to evaluate downstream.
Kept the project framed around public data preparation and marketplace support work rather than exposing internal decision logic or private operational process.
